marta-gonzalez: FYI: rolling out the Private Evidence Retention update for VPC/on-prem installs. This adds per-tenant retention windows, an export redaction workflow, and an admin consent audit trail. Pilot starts today, GA in two weeks.

evAN-choi: Nice—what retention windows are supported?

marta-gonzalez: Admins can choose 30/90/365 days for audit bundles and associated metadata. Default for GA tenants will be 365 days; pilot tenants default to 90. We log all export actions to the tenant audit log.

security-bot: Security note: redaction is allowed for hostnames/IPs but requires explicit admin approval; redaction events are appended to the chain-of-custody and signed. No private keys or unencrypted secrets are included in any export.

se-leads: CLI support for air-gapped customers? Need examples for runbooks.

marta-gonzalez: Yes. Example offline flow:

```
rwctl consent create --admin admin@org.com --cidrs 10.0.0.0/16 --out /tmp/consent.pdf
rwctl audit export --consent /tmp/consent.pdf --retention 90 --redact-hosts 10.0.1.5 --mode offline --out /tmp/evidence.zip
```

legal-ops: Please confirm attestation wording before GA. Also require an explicit consent checkbox in the Console UI that records the admin email and timestamp.

marketing-ops: We need a one-pager aimed at compliance officers and a short slide for Sales. Can SEs upload a sample attestation PDF to the internal playbook?

evAN-choi: Adding sample PDFs to Confluence now.

deploy-bot: Rollout note: feature-flag private.retention.v1 enabled at 1823456800; initial regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1. Monitor for export failures in the first 48h.

marta-gonzalez: Actions: SEs - add interested pilot accounts to tracker by 1823470000. Legal - review attestation language by 1823500000. Marketing - draft assets and ping SEs for review.

security-bot: Reminder: if customers want HSM-level proof, they must provide HSM logs; we only include HSM usage metadata in the bundle.

marta-gonzalez: Thanks everyone. Report any issues in #private-pilot and tag me. :thumbsup:
